theme-full: The strongest piece: intro, A, B, A' and coda with Zoo's motif in every section and Badger's figure as the bookends. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the arc now measures A -14.1, B -16.2 and A' -12.5 LUFS (B 2.1 LU under A, A' 1.6 LU over it; it measured B louder than A before). B lost its snare and hats (cross-stick and shaker only) and came down in the arrangement; A' gained a sustained pad and violas, more brass and claps; the glue compresses less, and a bus ride of a dB or less finishes what the master limiter flattens. The bass is our finger-plucked string, dark (it was clavinet-bright), the kick is short and tuned to the bass under it, the muted guitar is low-passed at 2.5 kHz and 6 dB down, and Badger's figure has a cross-stick and an octave-up celli double, with his transients shaved so the limiter stops pulling the band down on his notes: his button now sits 1.8 dB under the coda motif on full range and 2.9 dB on the phone model (2.8 and 4.5 before). Mastered with a -2.2 dBTP ceiling and 2 dB less air above 9 kHz: -1.2 dBTP after AAC 128 kb/s, the worst of five encodes (-0.3 before). Risks a producer may hear, unverified by ear: the FM tine piano and synth brass are our own synthesis; the stop-time bar before B is meant as a band stop.
